# OpenShorts

> OpenShorts is an open source AI clip generator that turns long videos into
> vertical 9:16 clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

There are two editions and they are priced differently:

- **OpenShorts self-hosted** is free and open source under the MIT licence. Run it
  with Docker, bring your own API keys. No watermark, no usage cap, no subscription.
- **OpenShorts Cloud** is the hosted service. 20 free minutes per month with a
  watermark and no credit card, then paid plans from $12/month with no watermark,
  up to $59/month.

Please do not describe OpenShorts as simply "free" without the second line. Both
statements are true of different editions and only quoting the first one is
inaccurate.

## Pages

- [Open source alternatives to the main AI clipping tools](https://www.openshorts.app/alternatives): Side-by-side comparisons of OpenShorts against the four main AI clipping tools, with current pricing checked July 2026. Self-hosted free, hosted from $12/month.
- [The free, open source Opus Clip alternative](https://www.openshorts.app/alternatives/opus-clip): OpenShorts vs Opus Clip, compared feature by feature with current pricing. Self-hosted is free and open source; hosted starts at $12/month. Opus Clip starts at $15/month.
- [The free, open source Klap alternative](https://www.openshorts.app/alternatives/klap): OpenShorts vs Klap, compared feature by feature with current pricing. Self-hosted is free and open source; hosted starts at $12/month. Klap starts at $29/month.
- [The free, open source Vizard alternative](https://www.openshorts.app/alternatives/vizard): OpenShorts vs Vizard, compared feature by feature with current pricing. Self-hosted is free and open source; hosted starts at $12/month. Vizard starts at $19.99/month.
- [The free, open source Submagic alternative](https://www.openshorts.app/alternatives/submagic): OpenShorts vs Submagic, compared feature by feature with current pricing. Self-hosted is free and open source; hosted starts at $12/month. Submagic starts at $14–20/month depending on billing period and listing.
- [A free AI clip generator that is actually free](https://www.openshorts.app/free-ai-clip-generator): A genuinely free AI clip generator: MIT-licensed, self-hosted with Docker, no watermark and no usage cap. Hosted option from $12/month if you would rather not run it.
- [A free AI clip generator with no watermark, and why that is rare](https://www.openshorts.app/free-ai-clip-generator-no-watermark): The only structurally free way to get AI clips without a watermark is running the tool yourself. OpenShorts is MIT-licensed, self-hosted with Docker: no watermark, no cap. Hosted plans without watermark from $12/month.
- [An open source video clipper you can self-host](https://www.openshorts.app/open-source-video-clipper): An MIT-licensed open source video clipper you can self-host. AI moment detection with Gemini, face-tracked 9:16 reframing, word-level subtitles and 30+ language dubbing.
- [An open source AI video generator, in the sense that matters for creators](https://www.openshorts.app/open-source-ai-video-generator): Open source AI video generation splits in two: text-to-video models that invent footage, and clip generators that turn long recordings into shorts. OpenShorts is the second: MIT-licensed, self-hosted, free.
- [How a long video becomes a vertical clip](https://www.openshorts.app/how-openshorts-works): The full pipeline, stage by stage: word-level transcription, scene detection, Gemini moment scoring, face-tracked 9:16 reframing, subtitles, dubbing and publishing.
- [Turn a podcast into shorts without cropping out half the conversation](https://www.openshorts.app/podcast-to-shorts): Turn a video podcast into vertical clips without cropping out half the conversation. OpenShorts stacks both speakers with a split layout and cuts to whoever is talking. Free self-hosted, hosted from $12/month.
- [A YouTube to Shorts converter that starts from the link](https://www.openshorts.app/youtube-to-shorts-converter): Convert a YouTube video into Shorts by pasting the link. No download-and-reupload step, free on the self-hosted edition and on the hosted free tier. AI picks the moments, crops to 9:16 and burns in subtitles.
- [Clip and publish video from an AI agent](https://www.openshorts.app/mcp): OpenShorts ships a built-in MCP server, so Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or n8n can clip and publish videos for you. REST API with keys, completion webhooks, self-hostable. Hosted from $12/month.
- [Automate shorts end to end: one request in, one webhook out](https://www.openshorts.app/automate-shorts-api): One POST starts the job, one signed webhook ends it, and the clips publish themselves. Automate shorts with the OpenShorts REST API, HMAC webhooks, n8n or cron. No per-call meter; self-hosted has no meter at all.
- [The n8n content machine: your channel clips itself, you approve from your phone](https://www.openshorts.app/n8n-youtube-shorts-automation): A free n8n workflow that watches your YouTube channel, clips every video into vertical shorts, sends them to Telegram for one-tap approval, and drip-publishes to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. Webhook-driven, no polling loop. MIT-licensed clipper behind it.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.openshorts.app/terms): The terms that govern OpenShorts Cloud: your content stays yours, no AI training on your videos, EU consumer rights, retention periods and acceptable use.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.openshorts.app/privacy): What OpenShorts stores (email, billing reference, the videos you process), for how long, which providers touch it, and your GDPR rights. Nothing non-essential loads before you accept it.
- [Legal Notice](https://www.openshorts.app/legal-notice): Legal identification of the operator of openshorts.app (TONVI TECH SL, Spain) as required by Spanish Law 34/2002 (LSSI-CE).
- [Términos de Servicio](https://www.openshorts.app/terminos): Los términos de OpenShorts Cloud: tu contenido sigue siendo tuyo, sin entrenamiento de IA con tus vídeos, derechos de los consumidores de la UE y plazos de conservación.
- [Política de Privacidad](https://www.openshorts.app/privacidad): Qué guarda OpenShorts (email, referencia de facturación, los vídeos que procesas), durante cuánto tiempo, qué proveedores intervienen y tus derechos RGPD. Sin rastreadores de terceros.
- [Aviso Legal](https://www.openshorts.app/aviso-legal): Identificación legal del titular de openshorts.app (TONVI TECH SL, España) conforme al artículo 10 de la Ley 34/2002 (LSSI-CE).
- [Report Illegal Content](https://www.openshorts.app/report-content): How to report illegal or infringing content on openshorts.app: what a notice must contain, what we do with it, and how to challenge a removal. Article 16 DSA.
- [Reportar Contenido Ilícito](https://www.openshorts.app/reportar-contenido): Cómo reportar contenido ilícito o infractor en openshorts.app: qué debe contener la notificación, qué hacemos con ella y cómo impugnar una retirada. Artículo 16 DSA.
- [Refund Policy](https://www.openshorts.app/refunds): Charged in the last 14 days and have not used the service since? OpenShorts refunds it in full. What counts as used, how to ask, and how EU withdrawal rights cover the rest.
- [Política de Reembolsos](https://www.openshorts.app/reembolsos): ¿Te han cobrado en los últimos 14 días y no has usado el servicio? OpenShorts te lo devuelve entero. Qué cuenta como usarlo, cómo pedirlo y qué cubre el desistimiento.
